name: plan-mode-structure
description: Plan composer mode emits YAML todos and an Out of scope section without file edits.

steps.content: Plan how to add a HelloWorld function to core/sample/main.go. Reply with YAML frontmatter that includes name, overview, and todos (each with id, content, status pending). After the YAML you MUST include a heading exactly "## Out of scope". Required literal strings in your reply: todos: and ## Out of scope. Use a mermaid flowchart if useful. Do not edit files.
